#!/usr/bin/python3
import os
import socket

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SOCKET_PATH = os.path.join(BASE, "run", "status.sock")
STATUS_PATH = os.path.join(BASE, "status.txt")
ERROR = b"ERROR\n"


def handle(client):
    client.settimeout(2.0)
    request = b""
    try:
        while b"\n" not in request and len(request) < 1024:
            chunk = client.recv(1024 - len(request))
            if not chunk:
                break
            request += chunk
        if request == b"STATUS\n":
            with open(STATUS_PATH, "rb") as status_file:
                client.sendall(status_file.read())
        else:
            client.sendall(ERROR)
    except (OSError, socket.timeout):
        try:
            client.sendall(ERROR)
        except OSError:
            pass


def main():
    os.umask(0o007)
    if os.path.lexists(SOCKET_PATH):
        os.unlink(SOCKET_PATH)
    server = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    server.bind(SOCKET_PATH)
    os.chmod(SOCKET_PATH, 0o660)
    server.listen(16)
    try:
        while True:
            client, _ = server.accept()
            with client:
                handle(client)
    finally:
        server.close()
        if os.path.exists(SOCKET_PATH):
            os.unlink(SOCKET_PATH)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
ANTRIEB_SERVER_EOF
install -o root -g root -m 0755 /tmp/status-server.py "$BASE/server.py"
chown root:statusd "$BASE/status.txt"
chmod 0640 "$BASE/status.txt"
chown statusd:status-readers "$BASE/run"
chmod 2750 "$BASE/run"
cat > /etc/systemd/system/statusd.service <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Local Unix socket status service
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=statusd
Group=statusd
SupplementaryGroups=status-readers
WorkingDirectory=/srv/legacy2/unix-socket-access-boundary
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/legacy2/unix-socket-access-boundary/server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1s
UMask=0007
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/srv/legacy2/unix-socket-access-boundary/run

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF

systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/statusd.service
